title: Asian Para Games: PH athletes miss podium in quiet Wednesday

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Allain Ganapin of taekwondo and Alyana Nunez and Wilson Sante Jr. of athletics fell short of the podium on a quiet Wednesday for the Philippines at the 5th Asian Para Games in Japan. Ganapin bowed to Iranian Paralympic silver medalist Mahdi Pourrahnamaahmad in the quarterfinals of the men’s K44 under-80-kilogram division before losing to Uzbekistan’s Otabek Amatov in the repechage, ending his bid for bronze.
